tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground. Warm white, never pure white, so white cards lift off it without a border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chart plots, menus, the search field. Everything that holds content sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: segmented control track, stream tags, kbd hints, hover fill on rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and dividers between rows. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised dividers, unlit meter segments, chart axis baseline, network links at rest.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (search field, secondary button). 3.5:1 on surface, 3.0:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface, surface-sunken, amber-soft and amber. 15:1 or better on all of them.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, legend names, chart end labels. 6.5:1 or better on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: mono labels, timestamps, axis ticks, placeholders. 5.0:1 on surface-sunken, 5.9:1 on surface. The faintest text allowed.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The phosphor accent. Fills only: primary button, lit lamps, the NOW marker, selection. Never text, never a stream colour. Text on it is on-amber.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for amber controls.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text or icon: rising deltas, active links. 5.3:1 or better on paper, surface, surface-sunken and amber-soft. Also the focus ring colour.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind amber-ink text: rising delta pills, the highlighted row, the projection band in trend charts.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber or amber-deep fill.

tokens.name: trend-up
tokens.usage: A signal that is heating up. Always paired with an up arrow and a signed number.

tokens.name: trend-down
tokens.usage: A signal that is cooling down. Text on surface (6.7:1) and trend-down-soft. Always paired with a down arrow and a signed number.

tokens.name: trend-down-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind trend-down text in delta pills.

tokens.name: trend-flat
tokens.usage: A signal holding steady. Paired with a flat arrow.

tokens.name: sev-quiet
tokens.usage: Severity 1 of 5, Quiet. Neutral on purpose: nothing is happening. Ink text on it (6.4:1).

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Severity 2 of 5, Low. Fill only; ink text on it (8.1:1). Always shown with the word and lit segments.

tokens.name: sev-elevated
tokens.usage: Severity 3 of 5, Elevated. Fill only; ink text on it (5.2:1).

tokens.name: sev-high
tokens.usage: Severity 4 of 5, High. White text on it (5.5:1); as text on surface or paper it reads at 5.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Severity 5 of 5, Critical. White text on it (9.2:1); as text on any surface 8:1 or better. Use for the alert lamp and critical banners only.

tokens.name: on-sev-strong
tokens.usage: Text on sev-high and sev-critical fills.

tokens.name: stream-1
tokens.usage: Stream slot 1, World. Marks only (dots, lines, nodes); labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: stream-2
tokens.usage: Stream slot 2, Tech. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-3
tokens.usage: Stream slot 3, Security and vulnerabilities. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-4
tokens.usage: Stream slot 4, reserved for the next stream added. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-5
tokens.usage: Stream slot 5, reserved. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-6
tokens.usage: Stream slot 6, reserved. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-7
tokens.usage: Stream slot 7, reserved. Marks only.

tokens.name: stream-8
tokens.usage: Stream slot 8, reserved. A ninth stream folds into Other (ink-subtle), never a new hue.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines inside chart plots on surface. 1px, solid.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart baseline and minor ticks of the tick ruler.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour. 5.3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight and the selected row in lists.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Sora carries everything people read: headlines, summaries, UI text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the edition or section title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Lead story headline and story page title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; story card headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Eleven outlets now report the same disclosure window.
styles.usage: Story summaries, fact claims, all running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: First reported by Nordic Wire at 05:40Z.
styles.usage: Secondary lines in lists, tooltips, helper text.

groups.name: Readout
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono carries everything the system measures: numbers, IDs, timestamps, labels. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The headline number of a Readout.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Secondary numbers: the threat level value, inline stat values.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Deltas, counts, values in tooltips and tables.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and section labels, set UPPERCASE in CSS. The main place the retro console voice shows.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks, timestamps, signal IDs.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous: cards breathe at space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segment gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip internals.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between meta items in a row; between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside compact cards; between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button and field side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; space between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and side margins on wide screens.

radius.note: Big and soft. Nothing on screen has a sharp corner; controls are pills.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd hints, tooltip swatches, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menu items, fact rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small cards, readout tiles, inner wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Story cards, chart panels, the threat meter.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Page level panels and hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, segments, lamps.

shadow.note: Warm, low, diffuse. Elevation is quiet; borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Chips and segmented control thumbs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, the lead story.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus, the command palette: anything floating.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: The halo of a lit amber lamp. The only glow in the system.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px white gap, then 2px of solid amber-ink, as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented options.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, signal chips.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The search field, primary page actions.
